title: Advanced Synthetic Image Detection Using Hybrid Feature Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.32538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the realm of generative AI, models such as GANs, MidJourney, DALL-E, and others have been continuously evolving to generate increasingly lifelike images. This rapid advancement has created an urgent need for robust methods to distinguish between real and AI-generated images. This paper proposes a novel approach for the detection of synthetic images by employing deep learning techniques for feature analysis. The proposed architecture classifies images by identifying variations that generative models struggle to replicate, particularly fine-grained textures and complex object features. Deformations in complexes are examined with the help of the CBAM architecture along with ResNet50. We have performed a selective patch-based analysis using Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) scoring, extracting the regions with the most and least complexity for further processing with an SRM Module and ResNet50 module. translated_title: 基于混合特征提取的先进合成图像检测方法
translated_abstract: 在生成式人工智能领域，GAN、MidJourney、DALL-E 等模型不断演进，能够生成日益逼真的图像。这一快速发展使得人们迫切需要稳健的方法来区分真实图像与 AI 生成的图像。本文提出了一种利用深度学习技术进行特征分析的合成图像检测新方法。所提出的架构通过识别生成模型难以复制的差异来对图像进行分类，尤其是细粒度纹理和复杂物体特征。借助 CBAM 架构与 ResNet50 对复合区域中的形变进行检测。我们采用离散余弦变换（DCT）评分进行了基于图像块的选择性分析，提取出复杂度最高和最低的区域，再利用 SRM 模块和 ResNet50 模块进行进一步处理。实验结果表明，我们的方法……
tldr: 本文提出一种混合特征提取的合成图像检测方法，结合CBAM、ResNet50、DCT评分和SRM模块，通过捕捉生成模型难以复制的细粒度纹理与复杂物体特征来有效区分真实图像与AI生成图像。
